narratives.Overview:
## Leftover of #4529

Recurrence: [PR 4809](https://github.com/deftai/directive/pull/4809) (#4783) on 2026-09-20. Grok through-merge parent started `pr:wait-mergeable-and-merge` while SHA-matched Greptile was 4/5 with a named CHANGELOG leftover, then parent-applied the residual with a temp script instead of a dest review-cycle subagent. Operator called that an improper babysit.

## What is broken

#4529 split implement (`stop-at: pr-open`) from the merge-path partner. The named partner is Approach 1 sibling **or parent-retained**, and Phase 6 squash is `pr:wait-mergeable-and-merge` (or parent-retained).

That pairing currently reads as: the parent conversation may be the review fixer, the waiter, and the closer. Approach 1 is still the default on grok-build when `spawn_subagent` is available. Parent-retained is ownership of **dispatch + closer**, not a license to skip the dest worker and patch the PR in the parent loop.

Three jobs got collapsed:

1. Fix findings — dest-cwd review-cycle residual (read all comments, one batch).
2. Wait — engine `pr:watch` / `pr:wait-mergeable-and-merge`, not a homemade poller.
3. Squash — same engine closer, only after CLEAN.

#2843 tells a swarm monitor not to self-implement, then carves Grok to Approach 1 or parent-retained, so parent-inline fix is skill-legal. That is the recurrence hole.

## Recut

When grok-build `spawn_subagent` is available:

- Named leftover on an already-touched PR file requires a dest review-cycle worker (not parent-as-leaf).
- `pr:wait-mergeable-and-merge` is only the CLEAN closer. Do not start it as the babysit while `clean_gate_holdout=confidence` and a named leftover exists.
- Dest spawn deny (`DEFT_ACTIVE_SCOPE` inherit, dest occupancy linger) must fail-loud. Do not silent-fallback to parent implement.
- Do not harvest a Grok `drive-to: merge-ready` continuation as this closer (still #4529).

Fail-closed follow-on (not required for first land): engine refuse of wait-merge while confidence holdout plus named leftover, unless the operator leftover-lands.

## Fences

- Do not reopen or recut #4529 implement `stop-at: pr-open`.
- Do not lower `minGreptileConfidence`.
- Do not treat #4771 / #4818 (Codex ApplyPatch stdin) as this dest inherit deny.
- Do not invent a new poller. Engine wait stays `pr:watch` then `pr:wait-mergeable-and-merge`.

Refs #4529 #2843 #4130 #2261 #4783

P1 is PR 4809 (#4783) 2026-09-20: Grok through-merge parent started pr:wait-mergeable-and-merge while SHA-matched Greptile was 4/5 with a named CHANGELOG leftover, then parent-applied the residual with a temp script instead of a dest review-cycle subagent. - content/skills/deft-directive-swarm/SKILL.md 158: Grok through-merge implement is stop-at pr-open. Named partner is Approach 1 sibling or parent-retained. Phase 6 squash via pr:wait-mergeable-and-merge (or parent-retained). Harvest drive-to merge-ready as that partner is forbidden.
- AGENTS.md Envelope SLA / Through-merge: Grok implement MUST be stop-at pr-open. Partner Approach 1 or parent-retained. Parent-retained is ownership of dispatch plus closer, not a silent Gap C handback — and not parent-as-leaf when dest spawn is available.
- SKILL.md review-cycle 379: Grok Build implementation leaves MUST NOT nested-spawn; they block on pr:watch or were scoped stop-at pr-open so the parent spawns the sibling. That is spawn-the-sibling, not parent-inline fix.

Inventory: #2843 swarm monitor must not self-implement, then carves Grok to Approach 1 or parent-retained. #4130 nest limits. Do not reopen #4529 implement stop-at pr-open. Do not lower minGreptileConfidence. No implement and no ingest from this parent.

## Verdict

The named refutation-target survives. On grok-build with spawn_subagent available, parent-retained is still an equal merge-path partner that tells the parent to poll/fix, because the #4529 carve-out removed the dest residual leaf that #2843 would otherwise spawn. #2655, #3032, and swarm SKILL.md:168 already tell the parent not to self-implement and not to yield without a review-monitor. Those sentences lose the collision: Envelope SLA plus Owner Continuity path B still make PR 4809-class parent-inline residual skill-legal.

Stop 1 pin-reads re-checked at 507c47576414bc7aef017068f4708d9324a0feab: swarm SKILL.md:158 is the Grok through-merge partner line; review-cycle SKILL.md:379 is the implementation-leaf nest forbid (parent spawns the sibling), not the parent-fixer license. Recurrence PR 4809 is merged (head 930cd3509842efbdbcb862a8131640b9805722cb).

## Finding 1 — sharpens-framing

The license to skip the dest worker is not Envelope SLA "or parent-retained" alone. Bound-remedy has to recut the sentences that name parent-retained as the fixer.

Evidence. review-cycle SKILL.md:541 path B: parent-retained next action is dual-source poll/fix. SKILL.md:581: parent-retained with an explicit next poll/fix action. SKILL.md:570: #2843 forbids monitor-inline fix and requires one dest continuation leaf, then #4529 forbids that continuation as a Grok drive-to: merge-ready coding leaf and substitutes Approach 1 or parent-retained. swarm references/core-phase-5-6.md:26-27 is the same carve-out. swarm SKILL.md:158 and AGENTS.md Envelope SLA list Approach 1 or parent-retained as equals. verify:l4-owner already refuses parent-retained as machine READY (packages/core/src/review-monitor/l4-owner.ts process path B only).

Failure mode. Harvest restates swarm SKILL.md:158 / Envelope SLA as "parent-retained means dispatch plus closer" and leaves L4-B and the #2843/#4529 carve-out in place. The next through-merge parent still reads poll/fix in this conversation when spawn_subagent exists. P1 stays skill-legal.

Disposition. Bind only if Bound-remedy names those L4-B / partner-merge-path / Phase 5-6 carve-out sentences as the edit set, and keeps parent-retained for closer plus post-merge scope:complete after a dest worker exists. Do not delete parent-retained as merge-path owner. Do not treat #2655 restatement as the recut.

## Finding 2 — sharpens-framing

"Dest review-cycle worker" is not Approach 1 poller-only and is not option-2 drive-to: merge-ready.

Evidence. Approach 1 (review-cycle SKILL.md:650-654, host-grok-build.md:44 path b) is dest-cwd review-monitor plus review-monitor:register. The poller template applies a fix batch on NEW P0/P1 and does not exit on P2; confidence holdout stays in the wait loop until CLEAN or TIMEOUT. Named leftover on an already-touched file is class A (review-cycle SKILL.md:186-190) even at SHA-matched 4/5 with P0=0 P1=0. The dest fixer that #2843 would spawn is the continuation leaf Grok through-merge carved out. Fence already forbids harvesting drive-to: merge-ready as the closer.

Failure mode. Harvest "spawn Approach 1" yields a dest poller that cap-waits clean_gate_holdout=confidence while a named CHANGELOG leftover sits on the PR (PR 4809 class). Harvest a Grok drive-to: merge-ready residual as that worker recreates #4529 P1.

Disposition. Bound-remedy names worker_role and envelope: dest-cwd one-shot residual (class A), stop-at after the push, then engine wait with pr:watch, then pr:wait-mergeable-and-merge only after CLEAN. That residual is not the closer and is not option 2. Approach 1 remains the wait owner after the residual lands, with verify:review-monitor / review-monitor:register.

## Finding 3 — sharpens-framing

Dest spawn deny already has a fail-loud path. Do not mint a second occupancy primitive.

Evidence. host-grok-build.md:32 (#4215): if native spawn_subagent is denied, record the deny text; CLI grok --cwd is last-resort dest-cwd, not a habit, and not dual-launch. Unique dest-lock stays #4066. Stop 1 fences #4771/#4818 (Codex ApplyPatch stdin) off this dest inherit. Injection/swarm: silent parent-primary patch after dest deny mutates the wrong tree and skips dest-place.

Failure mode. Harvest a new DEFT_ACTIVE_SCOPE / occupancy-linger gate. Or read #4215 as "record deny then parent-implement on primary". Recurrence is skipping both native dest spawn and CLI dest-cwd, then patching in the parent loop.

Disposition. Cite #4215. Add only the missing forbid: dest spawn deny is BLOCKED or dest-cwd residual (native, else CLI last-resort). It is not parent-primary residual. Do not recut occupancy live or Codex stdin.

## Finding 4 — footnote

pr:wait-mergeable-and-merge already one-probes SHA-matched NEW_P0_P1 with no cap wait (packages/core/src/pr-wait-mergeable/cascade.ts:248-261) and then cap-waits otherwise. Confidence holdout plus named leftover is not that NEW_P0_P1 exit, so wait-merge still cap-polls. Issue recut already parks engine refuse as fail-closed follow-on. Keep #4822 wait-verb swallow off this harvest.

## Finding 5 — footnote

Stop 1 cite of review-cycle SKILL.md:379 is the leaf nest-limit, not the parent-fixer license. The license is SKILL.md:541, :570, :581. Does not change P1.

## Road not taken

Rejected: leftover is prose because #2655/#3032/#2843 already forbid parent-as-leaf. Steelman: Approach 1 plus those MUSTs should have blocked PR 4809. What would flip that: L4-B and the #4529 carve-out gone, so parent-retained cannot be the fixer when spawn_subagent exists. They are still on the pin SHA, so restating #2655 without those edits would not close the hole.

Injection/swarm: dest spawn, dest-cwd residual, occupancy, and who may mutate the PR tree. Existing controls are dest-place (#4066), #4215 deny record plus CLI dest, Approach 1 lease (#2655/#3044), class A one-shot residual, pr:watch, wait-merge closer. Missing control is the dest residual envelope after the #4529 carve-out, plus the L4-B poll/fix sentence.

No successor lean. Dual-stop numbered post 1 of 6.
